members.devicesSignedOut: Signed {name} out on all devices ({count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}})

importWatch.itemClaimed: Identified; awaiting background organization into the library

extension.tokenRotated: New token generated; the previous token is invalid immediately
extension.driveCreated: Added as a cloud drive account

app.modelUpdateStarted: Model update started. Track it using the progress endpoint.
app.restarting: The app is restarting and will recover shortly
app.retentionSaved: The {count, plural, one {# most recent version} other {# most recent versions}} will be kept locally

services.siteHint: PT site (direct access is usually faster within China; enable a proxy as needed)
services.tmdbHint: Data for discovery and subscription setup from api.themoviedb.org
services.imageHint: Fetch poster and backdrop images from TMDB and site image hosts
services.fanartHint: Fanart.tv images: webservice.fanart.tv API and assets.fanart.tv image host
services.doubanHint: Douban charts and search; direct access usually works within China
services.webSearchHint: Agent web search using Tavily, Exa or Brave. These services often require a proxy within China
services.telegramHint: Send and receive Telegram bot messages through api.telegram.org; requires a proxy within China
services.discordHint: Send and receive Discord bot messages through discord.com and its gateway; requires a proxy within China
services.feishuHint: Feishu custom bot webhooks at open.feishu.cn usually work directly within China. International Lark at open.larksuite.com may require a proxy
services.webhookHint: Send playback, favorite and other events to external services. Targets are often on a local network; each endpoint can use direct access (default) or the proxy
services.movieclawCloudHint: Connection, renewal and reporting through api.movieclaw.io. No requests are sent when disconnected
services.movieclawPushHint: Official push.movieclaw.io and self-hosted public relays. Self-hosted local network relays always connect directly
services.pypiHint: Python packages needed by third-party plugins, from pypi.org by default. You can select the Tsinghua mirror below
services.githubHint: Check and download app updates through api.github.com and github.com. A proxy is often needed within China; UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_MIRROR is another option
